def get_clusters(df: pd.DataFrame, k: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Get clusters from a dataframe using k-means algorithm.

    Parameters
    ----------
    df: pd.DataFrame
        Dataframe containing the features.
    k: int
        Number of clusters.

    Returns
    -------
    dict
        Dict of cluster labels and centers.
    """
    # Scale the features
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    scaled_features = scaler.fit_transform(df)

    # Initialize KMeans model
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=k)

    # Fit the model to the scaled features
    kmeans.fit(scaled_features)

    # Assign the cluster labels to each row
    clusters = kmeans.predict(scaled_features)

    # Return the dictionary of cluster labels and centers
    return {'clusters': clusters, 'centers': kmeans.cluster_centers_}
